entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie... I hope you can help. I bought some cycling shoes a little while ago, and I need to return them. I'm just so disappointed.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF-8675309. I've been a VeloFit customer for years, and this has never happened before. I really needed this to work out.

I appreciate your loyalty, and I'll do my best to sort this out. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Mountain Bike Shoes, delivered on October 30th, which was 44 days ago. Can I ask, what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's the fit. I tried everything, I adjusted the cleats multiple times, but they just... they give me terrible blisters on every ride. I can't wear them.
Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. I understand completely. Let me just double-check our return policy for you. One moment.
Alright, thank you for waiting. I've checked our system, and it looks like you're well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process that return for you.
Oh, really? That's... that's a huge relief. I was so worried because I really needed that money back for bills. Thank you so much.

You're very welcome. I'm happy to help. I've just initiated the return. You'll receive an email with a prepaid shipping label within the next 15 minutes. Once we receive the shoes back at our warehouse, we will issue a full refund to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's perfect. You've been a great help, Charlie. Thank you again.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
